id.description: One word: the interaction's name; it must equal the file name without .json

label.description: The name shown in the menu; {target.name} fills in the target

actors.description: Who can do it: hero, person, animal or the name of a kind

target.description: What the interaction can be done to

tags.description: Tags the target must carry (edible, plant, hero, animal...)

kinds.description: Kinds of thing it applies to (bush, person, deer...)

range.description: How near the actor must be, in metres

order.description: Its place in a menu: lower comes first

effects.description: What happens, one effect line each, in order

menu.description: Empty for the ordinary menu of a thing; confront for the Confront menu of an NPC

note.description: The owner's own words; they are kept when the file is saved
note.example: Reach 2.5 m. Moving or attacking before the ring is full stops the job and gives nothing. Four seconds of work each time (do build-work 4).

duration.description: Seconds the job takes, with a ring that fills over the target; 0 is instant

requires.description: Conditions that must hold, each with the reason shown when it does not

if.description: The condition, in the rule language

else.description: The reason shown when the condition is false

npc.description: How clan members and animals decide to do it on their own

score.description: How much an NPC wants to do it now (a rule-language number)

cooldown.description: Seconds an NPC waits before choosing it again

chronicle.description: The chronicle sentence written when it is done, with the usual {tokens}
